evidence.why: Shows the signature, closed-stream return, three named orientation cases, and absence of a default or subsequent return.

facts.rationale: The declaration establishes the parameter and return types. The guard and named switch cases establish their respective results, but the source does not justify describing the switch as exhaustive over all possible stored orientation values.
facts.value: C stream-orientation function with signature int fwide(FILE* stream, int mode). It returns zero for a closed stream, the supplied mode when handling an unoriented stream, 1 for an already wide-oriented stream, or -1 for an already character-oriented stream. The switch has no default and the function has no trailing return, so no explicit result is provided for an orientation outside these named cases.
